access: Primary arXiv HTML/abstracts and official NeurIPS/CVF proceedings. Hopfield full PDF was unavailable through the web reader; its official abstract supports the limited equivalence statement below.

papers.title: Hopfield Networks is All You Need
papers.finding: Modern Hopfield networks have an explicit energy and an attention-equivalent update rule. This motivates an energy perspective for attention, not a guarantee of one potential for every component of a pretrained language model.

papers.title: Energy Transformer
papers.finding: An architecture deliberately constructed with a global energy: changed attention/value structure, tied Hopfield MLP weights, parallel contributions and recurrent dynamics. Section2 derives descent. These constraints cannot be assumed for our existing Qwen checkpoint.

papers.title: Transformers as Intrinsic Optimizers: Forward Inference through the Energy Principle
papers.finding: Theorem1 relates softmax attention to free-energy gradient descent with a hypersphere assumption and a specified relation between value and key/query matrices. The text explicitly acknowledges practical untied value matrices and layerwise parameters. It does not establish one globally descending residual-state potential for our Qwen generation process.

papers.title: A Simple Unified Framework for Detecting Out-of-Distribution Samples and Adversarial Attacks
papers.finding: Gaussian feature statistics and Mahalanobis distance are established anomaly scores. Our single baseline reference and fixed shrinkage are an adaptation, not a reproduction of its class-conditional detector or evidence of physical energy.

papers.title: Energy-based Out-of-distribution Detection
papers.finding: Defines a log-sum-exp energy from classifier logits, usable as an inference score. That is different from residual norm or residual Gaussian energy. Softmax probability alone does not identify the logit energy under a common logit shift; no LLM steering guarantee follows from the vision results.

papers.title: ViM: Out-of-Distribution With Virtual-Logit Matching
papers.finding: Combines feature components outside a principal space with logits for OOD detection. Here outside a tiny observed TRAIN span cannot be equated with outside the true model manifold, and untreated question changes also produce large scores.

papers.title: FishBack: Pullback Fisher Geometry for Optimal Activation Steering in Transformers
papers.finding: A local quadratic intervention cost, one-half delta^T J^T H J delta, approximates next-token distribution KL under small perturbations and the stated fixed-context map. This offers output-sensitive energy for future work. It needs the output distribution and downstream derivatives, absent from our residual-only archives, and is not a global Lyapunov potential.

assessment: Useful scalar monitoring is feasible now; a true global potential for the full pretrained residual/KV/recurrent generation dynamics remains unestablished. Individual residual vectors omit context and memory. An energy increase by itself identifies neither a specific steering direction nor its behavioral effect.
